observations.notes: Net EUR ex-works material per m; labour person-hours per m. Rebased from the per-m3 reference using a nominal 200 x 400 mm glulam section (0.08 m2) on the reference values of 1200.0 EUR and 8.0 h per m3, so the m basis is derived rather than sourced. The Elementplan element prices this product per m.
